verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed that https://developers.belvo.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Belvo Developer Portal index, which is independent hands-on confirmation. The docs also offer a 'Copy for LLM' button that exports each page as Markdown for agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the llms.txt index is, and no community reports of agents actually using these docs.
